decision.observation: Backing out restored a wider view: the pale slab cluster is on the left with a dark boulder in front of it, and the slope descends toward the center-right into open purple sky. Reticle is a tiny dot on sky. Green full, yellow hatched tail half.
decision.hypothesis: S did break the stall and gave room. The slope falls away to the right; the pass may lie further right rather than up this face.
decision.memory: Retreat with S plus yaw reliably restores the wide view from stalls.
